returns.funcs: The function selectors implemented by the facet.

returns.interfaces: The interface IDs implemented by the facet.

facetMetadata().details: Exposed to allow for single call retrieval of all facet metadata.

returns.functions: The function selectors implemented by the facet.
returns.interfaces: The interface IDs implemented by the facet.
returns.name: The name of the facet.

forceTimeoutSettlement((address[],uint25.details: Same finalStacks-direct accounting as {settleHand}, but the verifier      is skipped (§11.11) and any declared winner without a valid signature      forfeits their entire share to the operator (§11.10). v1 binds      `lastRoundState` to the hand by handId; verifying its all-player      signatures is deferred to a later hardening pass.

params.init: The original hand initialization (handId recomputed from it).
params.winnerSignatures: EIP-712 signatures from every address in `outcome.winners`.

assertHandMembership((address[],uint256[.notice: Activates a hand: verifies all players signed `init`, recomputes         the handId, and locks each player's buy-in.

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposits `amount` of the token into the caller's vault balance.

facetFuncs().notice: Declares the function selectors implemented by the exposing facet for use in a composing proxy.

facetInterfaces().notice: Declares the interfaces implemented by the exposing facet for use in a composing proxy.

facetMetadata().notice: Declares comprehensive metadata about the exposing facet.

facetName().notice: Declares a canonical nonunique name for the exposing facet.

lockedOf(address).notice: Amount of `player`'s balance currently locked across active hands.

oracle().notice: The configuration oracle resolved for rake + operator at settlement.

settleHand((address[],uint256[],address,.notice: Settles an active hand to vault balances, taking oracle rake.

token().notice: The ERC20 token this settler escrows.
